reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI as tool of surveillance and oppression
themes.definition: Concern that AI and digital technologies can serve surveillance, oppression and control, clashing with personal freedoms.
themes.inclusion: Include passages framing AI as a potential instrument of surveillance, oppression or control, or in tension with personal freedoms.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general human-rights-standards language with no surveillance/control dimension.
themes.boundary_cases: Health-sector AI introduced in a surveillance-vs-freedom framing counts here.

examples.quote: remain an enabler of human progress, rather than a tool for surveillance, oppression and control
a clash between personal freedoms and technological surveillance, including the tendency for a faster introduction of artificial intelligence into the health sector

themes.label: Innovations conforming to human rights standards
themes.definition: Calls for AI and emerging technologies to conform to ethical and human rights standards, including UN resolutions on human rights and digital technologies.
themes.inclusion: Include passages requiring AI to meet ethical/human rights standards or citing human-rights-in-digital-technology initiatives.
themes.boundary_cases: Mention of AI's influence on future conflicts within a rights framing may also be AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS if autonomous systems are stressed.

examples.quote: It is our duty to ensure that innovations — including artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, biotechnology and quantum computing — fully conform to our ethical and human rights standards.

themes.label: Ambition to lead in AI innovation
themes.definition: National innovation strategy aiming to implement AI across sectors and become a leader in AI.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on national AI/innovation strategies and leadership ambitions.
themes.boundary_cases: Cultural pride references (e.g. origin of the word robot) count when part of a national AI ambition.

examples.quote: Our goal is to become a European leader in innovation and artificial intelligence and a country that can serve as an example to the rest of the world.

themes.label: Disinformation and geopolitics of technology
themes.definition: Disinformation and foreign interference discussed adjacent to AI and technology geopolitics.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking disinformation or foreign interference with new technologies including AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude disinformation passages lacking any technology link.
themes.boundary_cases: Adjacent-sentence linkage (disinformation then AI) counts only if presented as part of the same technology challenge.

examples.quote: The geopolitics of technology continues to pose an ever-greater challenge to the established norms.

value.rationale: Czech passages (2019-2024) shift from a national AI leadership ambition to concerns about surveillance, disinformation and ensuring AI conforms to human rights standards.
